item.title: GovBrief Today #554
item.description: 264,000 Americans stopped looking for work last month. Nobody needs a government report to tell them the economy is worsening. Grocery and gas prices have climbed for more than a year while paychecks barely moved. Today's report showed where that leads. Stores and restaurants cut jobs because customers stopped spending, and more people decided looking for work was pointless. The share of Americans in the workforce fell to its lowest point in 50 years outside the pandemic. The unemployment rate actually went down because a quarter million people quit looking. And Trump answered the worst jobs report of his term by notifying Fed Governor Lisa Cook that he intends to fire her, six weeks after the Supreme Court blocked his first attempt. item.title: Two Metabolic Origins of Life - New Study
item.description: Two Metabolic Origins of Life - New Study Oktay Yürük aka Oktay74tn, science and tech content https://imgur.com/user/Oktay74tn This is the Beebe Vent Field near the Cayman Islands, the deepest known hydrothermal vent site in the world, 5 kilometers (3.1 miles) below sea level. It is a candidate for the origin of life. According to a new scientific study, there could be two metabolic origins of life. The phylogenetic tree of life describes the relationships between organisms. The three main groups are the domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya. LUCA, the last universal common ancestor, is the hypothetical latest common ancestral population of all single-celled organisms. This is the distribution of ribosomal and core metabolism protein families across bacterial classes shown in blue and archaeal orders in red (LBCA and LACA are the last common ancestors of bacteria and archaea). The enzymes that catalyze the reactions are not conserved across the evolutionary divide that separates bacteria and archaea. The two lineages made the transition to the free-living state independently. In this diagram, inorganic substrates are shown at the left. A network of about 400 reactions converts these compounds into amino acids and nucleobases, represented by one-letter codes, and cofactors. This network evolved over time. The pink and red nodes represent reactions catalyzed by transition metals. Adenosine triphosphate ATP is the energy molecule in living cells. An average human recycles 50 kilograms of ATP per day. Adenosine diphosphate ADP is the product of a palladium-catalyzed phosphorylation with phosphite. Proto-cells developed more and more enzymes over time until they became independent of metals. At the end of the process, free-living bacteria and archea emerged. Hot springs such as the Grand Prismatic Spring of the Yellowstone National Park are home to the robust archea. _________________________________________________________________ Intermediate stages in the origin of metabolism at a phosphorylating hydrothermal vent Natalia Mrnjavac, Nadja K.
